text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara looks back happily on how much 
fun she had running the Negishi Stakes all 
the way through.

Wanting her to approach races with a 
greater sense of tension, the Trainer 
suggested competing in a higher-tier race.

That race was... the GⅠ February Stakes. 
...Yet upon hearing this, Haru Urara 
simply reacted at her own pace as always: 
"Sounds like fun!"

Wondering how far she could fight with her 
lack of seriousness, the Trainer couldn't 
help but feel uneasy.
